Vierzig Jahre nach der Stille flackern d: Forty years after the Silence, the Builders' gates are flickering again. A prologue, five acts, four factions – and something coming through the gates. Your decisions travel with you all the way to the finale.
Zwei Geräte, jedes mit dieser Datei, im: Two devices, each with this file, on the same Wi-Fi or connected through a hotspot. One device hosts, the other joins. To link up, the devices swap two codes: by camera as a QR code, or copied and sent across.
Für Geräte in verschiedenen Netzen. Der: For devices on different networks. The code then also contains the public IP address of your connection, and public address services (STUN from Google and Cloudflare) learn it as well. Only give the code to players you trust. Behind strict networks you will also need a TURN server of your own.
Schritt 2 von 2: Antwort-Code des andere: Step 2 of 2: reply code from the other device
Schritt 1 von 2: Code des eröffnenden Ge: Step 1 of 2: code from the hosting device. Scan it with the camera or paste the copied code.
Der Kessel mit zwanzig Systemen. Jede Ru: The Caldera, twenty systems. One action per turn: attack, defend or fortify – then the other powers move, and gate storms carry the Brood into the Caldera. Systems you hold strengthen every battle, and your flagship gains rank over the whole campaign. Choose your faction.
Kampagne → Ausbildung führt in zehn kurz: Campaign → Training walks you through the controls in ten short steps. The button you need right now glows orange.
Zerstöre alle Stationen und Bauschiffe d: Destroy all enemy stations and Constructors. Anyone left with no station and no Constructor is eliminated.
Frachter bauen Eis an Eismonden und Erz: Freighters mine ice at ice moons and ore at ore rocks and deliver it to the Refinery. Reactors supply power; a shortage slows shield recharging and Shipyard production. Command points cap your fleet; relays give you more.
Bauschiff wählen, Station im Baumenü ant: Select a Constructor, tap a station in the build menu, then tap a spot. Stations can be upgraded through three levels and visibly change shape as they do. The Command Base is armed from level 2.
Labor wählen und eine Technologie antipp: Select the Lab and tap a technology, one at a time. Lab level II and III unlock more; the Lab also unlocks cruisers (level I) and capital ships (level II).
Ein Finger wischen verschiebt, zwei Fing: Swipe with one finger to pan, pinch with two to zoom. Tap to select; tap a target to give an order (move, attack, mine). Double-tap selects all ships of that type. Long-press empty space: attack-move. “Select” draws a box. Long-press a button to see what it does. Groups 1–5: tap to select, long-press to save. The Training Range in the main menu has everything unlocked, plus practice targets.
Strahlen sind stark gegen Schilde, kinet: Beams are strong against shields, kinetic weapons against armour and hull. Torpedoes hit hard but can be shot down by point defence. Ships have firing arcs; the ◎ button shows them. Kills earn experience.
Jedes Schiff hat Antrieb, Waffen, Schild: Every ship has engines, weapons, shields, sensors and life support. Hits on the hull weaken them; with the “Target” button you pick a subsystem for your ships to aim at in their next attack. Without life support the crew dwindles; without a crew a ship drifts as a wreck. A nearby Constructor can re-crew your own wrecks; enemy wrecks can be boarded.
Boarder und Dropship setzen Marines auf: Boarders and Dropships put marines aboard a target (“Board” button, then tap the target). Once the crew is beaten, the ship is yours. Weaken the crew first, then board.
Viele Schiffe haben eine Spezialfähigkei: Many ships have a special ability (orange button; long-press to see what it does). “Auto” lets the ship use it on its own. Flagships (one per side, Shipyard III) have three abilities; the doctrine adds a fourth.
Mit Kommandobasis Stufe II wählst du ein: With Command Base level II you choose a doctrine, once: permanent bonuses, an exclusive ship and a flagship ability. The cards show what each is strong or weak against.
Heldenschiffe mit Namen, Begleitdrohnen: Named hero ships, escort drones and light lances, some of which pierce shields. Fallen heroes rest as wrecks: a Restorer beside them revives them, rank and all. The Last Sovereign rises again once per match. Superweapon Sunbreaker: a stellar flare over an area.
Alles muss am Netz hängen: Stationen bra: Everything has to be on the network: stations need a connected node in range, or they shut down (“No network”). Harvesters deliver instantly as long as they are on the network. Three Shards merge into a Prism, three Prisms into a Monolith (“Merge” button). Binders take over enemies with little hull left. Superweapon Resonance: all small enemy ships in the area switch sides.
Lebende Schiffe ohne Schild, die sich vo: Living ships without shields that heal on their own; everything costs only biomass. Grazers eat ice, ore and wrecks (tap the wreck). Larvae are cheap and mutate at the tap of a button into a Swarm, Spitter, Ravager or Leech (cocoon; costs the price difference); Spitters become the Acid Maw. Acid keeps burning after the hit and ignores armour, bites go through armour, and parasites hatch into a swarm after 12 seconds. Spore carpets and spore nests heal the Brood and eat away at enemies. Leviathan and Matriarch devour damaged ships. Superweapon Brood Storm: a storm of swarms anywhere on the map.
Ein Prolog, fünf Akte und eine Bonusmiss: A prologue, five acts and a bonus mission, each with its own map, objectives and radio messages. Each act puts you in command of a different faction; in the finale you choose. Tap the radio message to page on, and tap “Objectives” to collapse the list. At three points you make a decision; it changes later missions and the ending. Progress and decisions stay saved on the device; “Continue” resumes a mission in progress.
Feldzug auf der Sektorkarte mit zwanzig: A campaign on a sector map of twenty systems. Tap a system: you can attack neighbours of your systems (and, through gate systems, any other gate) – as a real battle or auto-resolved. Your own systems can be fortified; when a power announces an attack, you can fend it off yourself, otherwise the fortification decides. Shipyard systems provide escort ships, relic worlds give relics and logs, resource worlds starting resources, gate systems jumps. Surviving veterans and the flagship keep their experience. Two advisors pull you in different directions; from the midpoint on, the Matriarch awakens at the Prime Gate. If your capital world falls, the campaign is lost.
Ein Schiff neben einer Ruine scannt sie:: A ship next to a ruin scans it: relics, a tech fragment, a map reveal or a trap. Great sites (Citadel, Archive, Warden, Star Forge) are held with warships; the map shows the progress. Relics (violet) are needed for jump gates.
Flackernde Tore öffnen sich alle 50 Seku: Flickering gates open briefly for everyone every 50 seconds. Dead gates are activated by holding them for 20 seconds and paying three relics. The owner chooses: Bridge (anyone can pass), Lock (owner only), Lance (charges for two minutes, then an energy blast hits everything at the partner gate; after the third, a gate storm). Passing through means flying through the centre of the gate.
Wird 25 Sekunden vorher angekündigt. Wer: Announced 25 seconds in advance. Anything caught in the open loses shields and hull; in the shadow of moons, asteroids, sites and stations you are safe.
Zwei Geräte mit derselben Datei, im selb: Two devices with the same file, on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot (or “Over the internet”). One device hosts and shows a code; the other scans or pastes it and answers with a code of its own. In the lobby, the host picks 1 vs 1, Co-op against two AIs, 2 vs 2 with AI partners, or Quarantine Line for two. Both devices compute the same match; orders take effect a moment later. Pausing applies to both. If the connection drops, the AI can take over the other side if you wish.
Mit Basis III und Labor II baubar (Reite: Buildable with Command Base III and Lab II (“Special” tab). It takes a long time to charge. Exodus Gate: moves all ships at the gate to a point on the map. Mass Driver: a heavy impact at one point, dangerous to your own ships too. The enemy gets a warning.
WASD/Pfeile verschieben, Rad zoomt, Rech: WASD/arrows pan, wheel zooms, right-click gives orders, Ctrl+right-click attack-moves, H stop, G hold position, 1–5 groups, Shift+number saves, P pause.
Reichweiten und Schussfelder der Auswahl: Show ranges and firing arcs of the selection
